entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andrej Tavželj is a Slovenian professional ice hockey player. He is currently under contract to Slovenian team HDD Jesenice of the Alps Hockey League. He participated at the 2011 IIHF World Championship as a member of the Slovenia men's national ice hockey team.
